instruction: Candid documentary photograph, medium full shot. In a modern living room, the woman in the blue button-down shirt (R1) stands on the left in profile, gesturing expressively with both hands raised. Facing her on the right, the man in the light green t-shirt (R2) speaks animatedly with his mouth wide open, hands raised near his face. They are engaged in a heated conversation, standing close but without touching. The background features potted plants and a blue wall art piece under bright, natural indoor light.
